title: Input Validation
description: Validate and sanitize all incoming data to prevent injection attacks.

data.text:
**Input Validation**

Untrusted input is the root cause of most injection attacks. Every piece of data from the client must be validated.

items: Manual validation for complex business rules
Always validate in the API layer

data.title: Data Annotations Example
Validation != Sanitization
data.text: Validation checks format and type. Sanitization removes or encodes dangerous content. Both are needed.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Validate type, length, format, and range
Use server-side validation as the authority
Sanitize data that will be rendered or executed
data.takeaway: Validating input is the cheapest way to block injection attacks.
